newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - March 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - March 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- South Korea's Hanbo group has withdrawn a proposal to invest $1 billion in a shipbuilding venture in the Philippines, officials at the Philippine Board of Investments said.

- President Fidel Ramos and Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda agreed to double the volume of trade between their countries from the 1996 level of about $250 million to $500 million by the year 2000. (MANILA BULLETIN)
Former Miss America Shannon Marketic files a sexual harassment suit against the Sultan of Brunei. (MANILA STANDARD)
- Transportation Network Pty Ltd, the state-run railway provider in South Africa, is interested in joining the bidding for the Mindanao railway project in the Philippines. (INQUIRER)
- Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Cielito Habito said he expects February inflation rate to rise only slightly from January's five percent. (Businessworld)
